text.p: Wienerberger Baustoffindustrie AG said on Thursday its nine-month earnings before interest and tax fell 5.7 percent to 1.32 billion schillings.
The group said in a statement its pre-tax profit fell 20.2 percent to 1.041 billion schillings on sales of 11.657, up 11.6 percent.
"1996 has been a challenging year due to the long and severe winter and the general decline in the construction industry," Wienerberger said.
But it said the figures had been boosted by a "good performance" during the third quarter and by Belgium's Terca group, which it acquired in April.

The biggest decline was in Wienerberger's wall, ceiling and roofing systems operations. Pre-tax profit slumped 36.7 percent to 540 million schillings, including Terca, versus 853 million in 1995 before the acquisition.
